title: Resolution Is Not Settlement, Part I: Oracle Adjudication and Semantic Governance on Polymarket
abstract: arXiv:2609.15368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prediction-market resolution is often reduced to a terminal outcome and one timestamp. That representation is inadequate for leveraged event claims because rule versioning, request creation, proposal, dispute, reset, Oracle finality, and adapter terminality are distinct states with different observation precision and balance-sheet consequences. We reconstruct those states for Polymarket using Oracle request generations as the unit of adjudication.   The population is frozen at Polygon block 79,721,080 and contains 185,550 initialized adapter-question instances and 350,703 decoded adapter logs. Exact requester-filtered extraction yields 504,332 decoded Oracle lifecycle events: 184,148 request creations, 159,447 proposals, 1,604 disputes, and 159,133 settlements. The accounting closes as 182,671 questions with at least one request plus 1,477 successor generations. Immutable chain identity and deployed request semantics provide exact linkag

translated_title: 裁决并非结算，第一部分：Polymarket 上的 Oracle 裁定与语义治理
translated_abstract: 预测市场的裁决过程通常被简化为一个最终结果和一个时间戳。这种表示方式对于杠杆化事件索赔而言是不充分的，因为规则版本化、请求创建、提案、争议、重置、Oracle 终局性以及适配器终结性是彼此不同的状态，具有不同的观测精度和资产负债表影响。我们以 Oracle 请求代次作为裁定的基本单位，重建了 Polymarket 的这些状态。总体数据冻结在 Polygon 区块 79,721,080，包含 185,550 个已初始化的适配器-问题实例和 350,703 条已解码的适配器日志。经请求者过滤的精确提取得到 504,332 条已解码的 Oracle 生命周期事件：184,148 次请求创建、159,447 次提案、1,604 次争议以及 159,133 次结算。账目核对结果为：182,671 个至少拥有一次请求的问题，外加 1,477 个后续代次。不可变的链上标识和已部署的请求语义提供了精确的关联……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文以 Oracle 请求代次为裁定单位，首次完整重建了 Polymarket 预测市场从请求创建到最终结算的多状态裁决生命周期，证明“裁决”远非单一时间戳所能刻画的终止事件。
en_tdlr: Using Oracle request generations as the unit of adjudication, this paper reconstructs the full multi-state resolution lifecycle of Polymarket, demonstrating that resolution is far more than a single terminal outcome and timestamp.
